data.narrative: The student regenerated missing Team Collaboration code, pattern-reviewed it, and measured create IDOR, accept IDOR, interpolated SQL, and email-fail leftover rows before fixing them with targeted prompts. VERIFY then landed already-member 409, empty name 400, unauth 401, non-admin 403, and invalid email 400. BREAK proved GET list still leaked another team's invites; FIX gated list on membership without a placeholder admin flag.
